data.acceptance:
1. The managed hook is installed before every receive-pack and reserves Knots legacy, canonical/control/archive, freeze-marker, and inbox namespaces for every actor kind.
2. Inbox paths are scoped to trusted credential ID and permit only create or fast-forward updates; canonical/control/archive updates require the dedicated integrator capability.
3. An armed per-repository freeze marker rejects both update and recreation of the legacy Knots ref with an upgrade-specific error.
4. A deploy compatibility floor prevents any older Diffinite binary from downgrading the persistent hook after freeze.
5. A verified service persona, rotating SSH credential, audited grant rail, deployment, and production readback require no human session or email-verification handoff.
